loyalty.heading: Loyalty points
loyalty.ratio: Points earned per currency unit spent
loyalty.ratioHint: E.g.: 0.1 = 1 point earned for every 10 [currency] spent. A point's redemption value is the exact inverse of this rate. Setting it to 0 disables the loyalty program.
loyalty.tiersHint: Bronze is the base tier (1× multiplier, no threshold). A customer reaches Silver/Gold once their lifetime point total (never reduced by a redemption) exceeds these thresholds, and then earns points at the rate above multiplied by their tier's multiplier.

maintenance.heading: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: Code separate from user accounts, used to authorize maintenance actions (installing an update) — useful if the installer doesn't have the client's Admin password.
maintenance.updateHint: Choose the installer file (.exe/.msi) you brought, enter the maintenance code — the app attempts an automatic local backup (if a backup folder is configured above), then launches the installer. The backup is not blocking: if it fails, installation continues anyway with a warning. WariBox no longer closes automatically: you control when it closes, once the installer is visible on screen.
maintenance.updateWarning: The installer is not digitally signed. If Windows shows a blue "Windows protected your PC" screen (SmartScreen), that's normal — click "More info" then "Run anyway". If this screen appears in the background without you noticing and WariBox closes first, the update may seem to do nothing: that's exactly why closing is now manual. Also prefer the .exe file over .msi when both are available: it installs per-user, without an extra Windows authorization (UAC) prompt.
maintenance.closeNow: Installer is open — close WariBox now
